title: TOC page styling: title page and TOC typography
description: Style the title/cover page (title.css) and the TOC page (toc.css). Covers copyright placement, cover typography, link colors, indentation, leader dots, and font sizes.
success_criteria: toc.css exists in the PDF css directory
Use the same fonts family as mkdocs
The title is 'Contents'
'Contents' is aligned left
'Contents' font size is 2em
'Contents' font weight is 400
TOC title has a gray bottom border
TOC title gray bottom border ends .75 inches from left and right page edges
The left margin of the table list is 0.75 inches
The right margin of the table list is 0.75 inches
TOC links are black with no text decoration
Chapter numbers in TOC labels match the numbered headings in the markdown source
Depth-0 (chapter) entries are flush with the left margin (no extra indent)
Leader dots terminate at a consistent column 1 inch from the right page edge
Leader dots use a spaced pattern (not a single tight dotted line)
Depth-0 (H1/chapter) entries use 18px font size
Depth-1 (H2) entries use 16px font size
Depth-2 (H3) entries use 14px font size
Depth-3 (H4) entries use 14px font size
Depth-0 (H1/chapter) entries use bold font weight
All page numbers use font size 16 font weight 300
H1 (chapter headings) display the chapter number
There are no blank TOC pages
The TOC PDF is present in the output directory when this task is completed
